 Print Ahaan Panday and Sharvari are set to share screen space for the first time in 'Beparwah', an upcoming romantic action drama directed by Ali Abbas Zafar and produced by Aditya Chopra . The makers unveiled the film’s title and teaser poster on Monday, confirming a worldwide theatrical release on March 26, 2027. The film also features Bobby Deol and Aaishvary Thackeray in supporting roles, while details about its storyline remain under wraps. ‘Beparwah’ title and release date announced
 The makers revealed the title alongside a teaser poster, introducing the film with the tagline, “Fearless in love… #Beparwah in cinemas on 26th March 2027.” Watch Ahaan Panday Joins Ali Abbas Zafar For Another Career-Defining Action-Romance; Details Here While the announcement confirms the film’s romantic action genre and its release date, the makers have not yet disclosed details about the plot or the characters. With Ali Abbas Zafar at the helm and Aditya Chopra backing the project, Beparwah brings together a fresh lead pairing in a story that combines romance and action. Ahaan Panday and Sharvari collaborate for the first time
 'Beparwah' marks the first on-screen collaboration between Ahaan Panday and Sharvari. Ahaan gained wider recognition among Hindi film audiences with Saiyaara, which brought him into the spotlight and raised expectations around his subsequent projects. Sharvari, meanwhile, has explored different genres, including action, romantic drama and horror-comedy. She was recently seen in Imtiaz Ali’s period romantic drama 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' and also featured in 'Alpha', a Yash Raj Films Spy Universe action film co-starring Alia Bhatt. Hrithik Roshan also made a cameo appearance in 'Alph'a. The film received mixed audience reviews, with ETimes rating it two out of five stars. Poll Vote & Share your view
